===============================================================================
METADATA FOR THIS DATASET
===============================================================================

Dataset Title: CivicComp-HiEn: A Hindi-English Benchmark for Civic Complaint Classification
Original Creators: Vivek Mathew, Haji Shariefullah
Research Team: Shyam Tripathi, Kothamasu Hridayesh, K. Ashwini
Affiliation: Amrita School of Computing, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Chennai, India
License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International
License URL: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
Date Published: 03-02-2026
Source URL: https://newdata.opencity.in
Dataset URL: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/shyamtripathi373/civiccomp-hien-hindienglish-civic-complaints
Associated Paper: "CivicComp: A Hindi–English Corpus for Automated Civic Complaint Categorization"
Modifications: 
  - Removed unnecessary columns and all personally identifiable information (PII)
  - Regenerated unique identifiers using standardized format (BBMP_0000001)
  - Added Hindi and Hinglish translations aligned with original English complaints
  - Created train/test/dev splits for machine learning applications
  - Enhanced for benchmarking civic complaint classification tasks
